AB.name: Alberta

sbd._note: Alberta small business rate: 2% on first $500,000 (effective July 1, 2020). The small business deduction is 6%, resulting in a net small business rate of 2%.

AB._note: Alberta corporate tax administered by province. Rates verified against Alberta.ca corporate tax page (2026 review); matches long-standing 2% / 8% structure on $500,000 business limit.

sbd._note: BC SBD: 2% on first $500,000 (uses federal limit)
Manitoba SBD: 0% (nil) on first $500,000 (uses federal limit)
NB SBD: 2.5% on first $500,000 (uses federal limit)
NL SBD: 2.5% on first $500,000 (reduced from 3% effective January 1, 2024, uses federal limit)

NS.name: Nova Scotia

sbd._note: NS SBD: 1.5% on first $700,000 (reduced from 2.5% effective April 1, 2025, limit increased from $500,000 effective April 1, 2025)

NS._note: Nova Scotia has rate and limit changes effective April 1, 2025. For full 2025 tax year, using post-April 1 rates.

sbd._note: NT SBD: 2% on first $500,000 (uses federal limit)
NU SBD: 3% on first $500,000 (uses federal limit)
Ontario SBD: 3.2% on first $500,000 (uses federal limit)

PE.name: Prince Edward Island

sbd._note: PE SBD: 1% on first $600,000 (limit increased from $500,000 effective July 1, 2025)

general._note: PE general corporate rate: 15% (reduced from 16% effective July 1, 2025)

PE._note: PEI has rate and limit changes effective July 1, 2025. For full 2025 tax year, using post-July 1 rates.

sbd._note: Saskatchewan SBD: 1% on first $600,000 (provincial limit differs from federal)

QC.name: Quebec

effectiveRates._note: For taxation years beginning before April 30, 2026, the Quebec minimum small business rate remains 3.2%.
For taxation years beginning after April 29, 2026, Revenu Quebec increased the SBD rate to 9.3%, reducing the minimum small business rate to 2.2%.

sbd._note: Quebec small business rate depends on taxation year start date in 2026. Combined with federal 9% SBD rate = 12.20% before April 30 starts, or 11.20% for starts after April 29.

general._note: Quebec general corporate rate: 11.50%. Combined with federal 15% general rate = 26.50% provincial+federal component before surtaxes.

QC._source: Revenu Quebec corporate tax documentation and Revenu Quebec tax news: Increase in the Small Business Deduction Rate, published May 4, 2026.
QC._note: Quebec administers corporate tax separately from CRA. For taxation years beginning after April 29, 2026, the Quebec SBD rate increases from 8.3% to 9.3%, reducing the minimum eligible small-business rate from 3.2% to 2.2%. Other SBD conditions, including remunerated-hours rules, remain out of scope.

sbd._note: Yukon SBD: 0% on first $500,000 (uses federal limit)

_note: Provincial/territorial lower (small business) and higher (general) rates and business limits reconciled against the CRA ‘Corporation tax rates’ table (May 2026 page review). Alberta: alberta.ca corporate rates. Quebec: combined with Revenu Québec / public 2026 budget summaries (no announced rate change to these parameters as of review). Dual-rate provinces: if a rate changed mid-year, CRA requires day-count proration — this calculator applies the current table rates for arithmetic illustration.
